headline: Higher gold prices lift revenue and cash flow
summary_short: OR Royalties earned revenue of $90.2M, up 26% year over year, on 20,237 gold equivalent ounces, with a 96.8% cash margin.
summary_long: Volumes were flat; the revenue gain came from a realized gold price of $4,304 per ounce versus $3,434. Net earnings fell 33% to $55.4M because last year included a $54.4M non-cash gain, while adjusted earnings rose 28% to $53.9M. The company bought back $29.1M of shares and ended with $76.7M cash and $228.2M debt. It is on track for about the midpoint of its 80,000 to 90,000 GEO guidance for 2026.
confidence_notes: Adjusted earnings and cash margin are non-GAAP measures as defined by the company. Amounts are in US dollars. The release lists Q3 2025 GEOs as 20,326 in the table.

drivers.explanation: The company says its 96.8% cash margin converted higher precious metals prices almost entirely into cash on comparable GEOs earned; realized gold price was $4,304/oz versus $3,434.
Q3 2025 included a $54.4 million non-cash gain on the deemed disposal of an associate, which inflated the prior-year base.
Three new mines entered production in 2026, and the company remains on track for about the midpoint of 2026 GEO guidance.
